messages:
ryan: thinking about adding a client-ip-based region hint at the edge — set x-rw-region-hint from IP -> geo db and pass it to the gateway so routing prefers that zone. aim: shave ~30-60ms for mobile latencies. any red flags?

cate: NAT / CGNAT means many mobile users will cluster to a single IP -> biasing could overload a region. also privacy implications, we should be explicit in docs.

ben: agree with cate re: concentration. + quotas: if we route by hint we need per-tenant per-region headroom and fallback quotas so a single tenant doesn't explode a region.

alyssa: proposal: accept hint but treat it as a soft preference. Routing rules: prefer hinted region when healthy and under headroom; otherwise fallback by latency. Also add a short TTL so clients can be rebalanced quickly. thinking TTL=30s for hints + 60s grace before ejection to avoid flapping.

diego: +1 on grace. also we should track routing.hint_applied and routing.hint_miss metrics, and a histogram of failover.latency_ms. dashboards need to show per-tenant regional distribution.

ryan: here's a quick config sketch for the gateway rule (envoy-ish):

```yaml
- match: route_prefix: "/v1/generate"
  headers:
    - name: "x-rw-region-hint"
      as_preference: true
  policy:
    prefer_hint: true
    hint_ttl_secs: 30
    grace_before_eject_secs: 60
    fallback: latency_based
```

cate: looks reasonable. question: if hint header absent, do we want client-ip -> hint logic at edge or leave it to gateway? putting it at edge reduces weight on gateway but duplicates geo db logic.

ben: recommend computing hint at CDN/edge (fast path) and setting header. Gateway should be dumb consumer of the header and enforce headroom/quota checks. keeps centralized quota logic in one place.

alyssa: rollout UX: feature-flag the edge hinting and gate by tenant_id list. start with internal tenants and 1% of production. Add realtime toggle in Console for ops to disable per-region for a tenant.

diego: telemetry todo: emit these metrics: ["routing.hint_received","routing.hint_applied","routing.hint_rejected_reason","routing.failover_count","routing.failover_latency_ms"] tag by tenant, region_from, region_to. Also trace span when fallback occurs.

ops-bot: deploy initiated: routing-hint-service v0.3 -> canary 5% (sha: f2e9c1e).

ryan: tests: add unit tests for hint precedence, and an integration sim that replays mobile IP churn to validate ejection grace avoids oscillation.

cate: dashboard request: new panel showing tenant regional skew + 95p latency delta when hint applied vs not. helps quantify benefit.

ben: one more: quota accounting must attribute tokens to the region where request was served, not where hint pointed, to avoid sneaky cross-region billing mismatches. update billing docs.

alyssa: agreed. action items:
- ry an: add hint ttl config + header parsing (ryan)
- ben: design per-tenant region headroom & quota check (ben)
- diego: telemetry + dashboard panels (diego)
- cate: privacy blurb + docs (cate)
- ops: rollout canary and monitor routing.hint_rejected_reason (ops)

ryan: I'll prototype the edge header code this afternoon and post a short PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
